_schema.description: Decisions made by hand when scripts/vec_nominations.py matches the VEC's candidate list to the tracker. Key: '<district or region id>|<name exactly as on the VEC list>'. Value: the tracker name that is the same person, or null when the VEC name is a different person (a new row). Only needed where the automatic rules (same name; same first name and surname; near-identical spelling; same party and surname) get it wrong. Once a row is matched it carries ballot_name, so later runs don't need the entry.
_schema.notes: Why each entry was made, keyed the same way
